decisions.reason: Although technically related to our dosimetry know-how, the weak website progression from a standalone launch to only a later mention, combined with its niche particle-therapy scope and regulatory limits, suggests limited traction and a weaker learning-and-scale payoff than our core QA lines.

This small volume ionization chamber sits directly inside our core calibration and radiation-measurement capabilities, and its continued standalone presence indicates enough fit and feedback potential to justify further refinement and commercialization.

As another small volume ionization chamber closely aligned with our established dosimetry expertise, we are well placed to absorb user feedback, improve performance, and support it through our calibration and service infrastructure.

A standard clinical ionization chamber is highly complementary to our existing QA, calibration, and training business, so keeping it strengthens a core product area where our prior knowledge and customer access are strongest.

An ionization chamber for relative dosimetry builds squarely on our longstanding measurement competence and fits routine clinical workflows, making it a product where our absorptive capacity should translate into steady incremental improvement and sales support.

The thimble ionization chamber matches our established technical base, accredited calibration resources, and clinical customer needs, so it remains a strong candidate for continued market support rather than withdrawal.
